subject: ConvergeAI runtime tracing & prompt-tooling harmonization
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@convergeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ConvergeAI runtime tracing & prompt-tooling harmonization

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We chatted internally and want to align on two parallel tracks so we can validate ConvergeAI as an ISV integration for Redwood Dedicated/Private customers:

1) Runtime tracing: how ConvergeAI emits span/timing metadata for LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK calls (format, required fields, sampling tradeoffs).
2) Prompt-tooling compatibility: hooks for prompt templates, paramized prompts, and traceable prompt ids so our Optimize/Quality tooling can map regressions back to your guidance.

Concrete asks for the next week:
- Can you share a short integration checklist we can run in our sandbox (model versions, SDK versions, sample trace payloads)?
- Can Tom (cc'ed) provide an example LangChain trace JSON and a LlamaIndex call trace for a typical retrieval + generation flow?
- Proposed sandbox window: May 12–16, with a short sync on May 13 (30m).

I've attached a living checklist and a compatibility notes doc to get us started. We'll confirm a small set of test prompts and the acceptance criteria (latency, token accounting, trace fidelity).

Thanks — looking forward to toggling this to a pilot.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment: convergeai-integration-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: prompt-tooling-compat-matrix.md (text/markdown)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@convergeai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom@convergeai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ConvergeAI runtime tracing & prompt-tooling harmonization

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attaching an initial LangChain trace example and a short README describing our trace fields (trace_id, span_id, op_type, model_name, prompt_id, input_tokens, latency_ms). Tom added a LlamaIndex example as well.

We can do the sandbox run May 13 at 10:00 PT — Tom and I will provision a ConvergeAI dev stack accessible from your sandbox VPC and push the sample traces to an S3 bucket you control.

A couple of notes up front:
- Our SDK (v2.4.x) adds a lightweight trace envelope by default; we can toggle verbose spans for the sandbox.
- Prompt ids are optional on our side but we'd like to recommend a small schema (string namespace + short hash) so Optimize can map prompts deterministically.

I'll attach the files and a short checklist. If you want, Vanessa can lead a brief runbook acceptance step for procurement/SLA items.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, ConvergeAI
elena@convergeai.com

[Attachment: converge_langchain_trace_example.json (application/json)]
[Attachment: converge_llamaindex_example.json (application/json)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@convergeai.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom@convergeai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ConvergeAI runtime tracing & prompt-tooling harmonization

Elena —

Perfect, thanks for the examples. Quick clarifications before we spin up sandbox:
- Can the trace examples include a full HTTP example (headers + body) so our runtime team can validate ingestion mapping?
- For prompt ids, the schema you suggested works; can you add an example of the namespace prefix you recommend? (e.g., "conv_" + 8-char hex).

We added an acceptance checkbox in the checklist for "trace -> Optimize mapping validated" and one for "token accounting parity" (we'll run a paired test with our token counter).

Confirming May 13, 10:00 PT for the sync. I'll have a small runtime engineer (Marissa) join for mapping questions and Vanessa will own procurement/SLA items.

Onward —
Karthik
